design: Paired seed extension of the paper's original 15x15 ablation, separate from the Taillard fine-tuning experiment.

train.episode_sampling: Python Random(7000 + seed), uniform with replacement, same ordered draws within each seed
train.selection: fixed final update, no evaluation-based selection; no pretrained or Taillard-fine-tuned weights

evaluation.mode: one deterministic greedy schedule per model/instance
evaluation.historic: Re-evaluate the nine archived CPU-trained final models separately. Refit seeds 1–3 as well as 4–10 for the primary uniform CUDA-optimization cohort.

statistics.difference: T4 minus comparator makespan, negative favors T4
statistics.estimand: equally weighted paired mean over seeds and test cases
statistics.interval: Two-way crossed percentile bootstrap; independently resample 10 seed indices and 30 instance indices with replacement, share both index vectors across arms
statistics.test: Two-sided exact sign-flip test on the ten paired seed means over the fixed 30 instances; enumerate 1024 sign assignments
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the two planned contrasts
